questions.q: Fra Luca Pacioli is historically significant in the development of financial accounting primarily for which of the following contributions?
options: Inventing the abacus for calculating corporate profits
Publishing the first detailed printed description of the double-entry bookkeeping system
Establishing the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)
Creating the first set of unified taxation laws for businesses
questions.explain: Fra Luca Bartolomeo de Pacioli, often referred to as the father of accounting, published *Summa de arithmetica, geometria, proportioni et proportionalita* in 1494. This book contained the first published detailed description of the **double-entry accounting system**, laying the foundation for modern financial accounting.

questions.q: Which of the following best describes the primary function of financial accounting?
options: Systematically recording, classifying, summarizing, and reporting financial transactions to show a business's performance
Providing detailed, forward-looking cost estimations for management decision-making
Calculating the exact amount of Value Added Tax (VAT) a company owes to the government
Auditing the financial records internally to prevent employee fraud and theft
questions.explain:
The primary nature and function of **financial accounting** is the systematic process of recording, summarizing, and reporting past financial transactions to present the financial position and performance of an entity. 

*   Option **B** describes *Management/Cost Accounting*.
*   Option **C** describes *Tax Accounting*.
*   Option **D** describes *Internal Auditing*.
